taxonChips: Choose the taxa to return. Browse one rank at a time or all of them at once, and add as many as you like at any mix of ranks. Results include everything within each taxon chosen, so a family brings back its genera and species.
placeChips: Choose the states and counties to return. A state includes all of its counties, and the two can be mixed, so a whole state plus a few counties in another is one search.
coordRange: Limit results to a bounding box, given in decimal degrees. South and west are negative. Leave a box empty for no limit on that side.
timeRange: The years to return, set with the two handles. Months and days are optional and narrow the range further; choose a month before a day.
datasetSelect: Search for wildlife data within specific datasets. Selecting a dataset alters search options to only include taxa and locations in the selected dataset(s).
dataTypeSelect: Return only specific data types (occurrence, abundance, or density).
covars: Select environmental covariates to join with the wildlife data. Each is attached to the observation, site or species it varies with. Use 'About these covariates' for what each one measures, where it comes from, and any usage notes from the provider.
